result.summary: Found 2 issues: a misspelled search placeholder and inconsistent favorite-icon styling on popular restaurant cards.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' - 'Restarants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'

issues.description: Favorite heart icon styling is inconsistent in 'Popular right now' cards: Tokumaru Ramen Bar heart has no background circle while the pizza card below has a dark circular background, making the top icon lower contrast and look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent heart button style with dark translucent circular background for all restaurant cards
